==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Is a dual citizen of Belgium and Turkey.
* Uses AZERTY keyboard.
* His summoner name is his real name reversed and replaced "a" with a "q".<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fAZZCk92qzs&t=20s "You're going to WORLDS man!" | LEC Highlights Summer Playoffs Week 2 presented by Hisense] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* He is a good friend of [[Kameto]] (founder and president of Karmine Corp), and casted many [[Karmine Corp]] games on Kameto's Twitch channel.
* He is friends with [[Closer (Can Çelik)|Closer]].
* Speaks French, Turkish and English fluently.
* Is the 4th player to win a title in both [[LEC]] and [[LCS]] after [[Zven]], [[Perkz]], and [[BrokenBlade]].
* Reached 1000 kills in the LEC on July 14, 2024.
** The 15th player to reach 1000 kills in the LEC after [[Rekkles]], [[Jankos]], [[Perkz]], [[nukeduck]], [[Caps]], [[Wunder]], [[Kobbe]], [[Hans sama]], [[Odoamne]], [[Upset]], [[Larssen]], [[Carzzy]], [[Humanoid]], and [[Patrik]].

=== Individual Awards ===
* 1x NA 1st All Pro Team (Spring 2020)
* 1x NA 2nd All Pro Team (Summer 2019)
* 2x NA 3rd All Pro Team (Spring 2019, Summer 2020)
* 1x EU MVP (Summer 2022)
* 2x EU 1st All Pro Team (Summer 2022, Spring 2023)
* 1x EU 2nd All Pro Team (Winter 2023)
* 1x EU 3rd All Pro Team (Summer 2021)
